query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scaleup_scenarios (
  id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  analysis_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  scenario_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  temperature DECIMAL(10, 2),
  pressure DECIMAL(10, 2),
  mixing_speed DECIMAL(10, 2),
  addition_rate DECIMAL(10, 2),
  hold_time DECIMAL(10, 2),
  predicted_yield DECIMAL(5, 2),
  predicted_quality VARCHAR(100),
  predicted_cycle_time DECIMAL(10, 2),
  predicted_cost DECIMAL(15, 2),
  success_probability DECIMAL(5, 2),
  confidence_level DECIMAL(5, 2),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_analysis (analysis_id)
);
